title: Work at the far end of a 3500 x 1000 mm panel with the wire attachment unmeasured
rationale: Until rung R0b measures where the wires attach, every point of the body hull counts (safety-model 6.4; PHYS-05). At C = 140 the rear wheel is at (3358, 868) and its hull point reaches 3584 mm from tower 1, beyond reach_max = 3500 mm, while every wheel disc is inside WA_wheel. The design's case list uses a 3050 x 1530 mm panel; safety-model 6.4 shows that on that panel P-REACH refuses nothing W-AREA has not refused already, so the case uses the document's own example, a 3500 x 1000 mm panel, and RT32b pins the 3050 x 1530 reading.
